text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho's peer struggles to take her first step back onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy says that Sweep Tosho's magic left her eager to continue racing, and helped her find her courage. And yet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she watches the Takarazuka Kinen on TV, she feels she'd be unable to even stand beside Sweep Tosho, and that there's an invisible wall between them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the frustration lingers… Could it be that she actually wants Sweep Tosho to cast some magic on her too?
